card.name: Drug interaction section headings, direction of effect
card.fires_on: The word Affect (or the on/to before it) in Drug Interactions subsection titles such as 'Effect of Other Drugs on X' or 'Potential for X to Affect Other Drugs'. It sits where the heading says which drug acts on which.

modes.label: Affect in heading
modes.description: The 'ffect' piece of 'Affect' in a 'Potential for ... to Affect' heading.
modes.example: 7.2 Potential for Other Drugs to A<<ffect>> RUKOBIA Coadministration

modes.label: On/to in heading
modes.description: The linking word 'on' or 'to' in 'Effects of Other Drugs on X' headings.
modes.example: 7.1 Effects of Other Drugs<< on>> Regadenoson • Methylx

card.writes: It promotes words meaning reverse, vice versa and reciprocal, suggesting the opposite direction of the effect.
card.plain: It marks drug-interaction headings that say which drug affects which, and hints that the reverse direction comes next.
